articles.title: UN agency moves Stellar blockchain payment initiative beyond pilot stage
articles.snippet: The UN Development Programme said blockchain payment pilots in five countries cut costs, improved resilience and will now inform wider use across its humanitarian and development programs.

articles.title: Bitcoin nears $63.5K into weekly close as trader warns of 'terrible' Monday
articles.snippet: Bitcoin reached its highest levels in nearly a fortnight over the weekend, but BTC price action faced an "absolutely terrible" Monday track record.

articles.title: FBI Director Kash Patel's Undisclosed Stock Buy in Bitcoin Giant Strategy Is Down 44%
articles.snippet: FBI Director Kash Patel failed to disclose a significant purchase of stock in Bitcoin treasury firm Strategy from last November.
